summary.text: Jay Obernolte is the Republican incumbent for California's 23rd District, a video-game developer with degrees in engineering and artificial intelligence. He served on Big Bear Lake local boards, as the city's mayor, and in the California Assembly before his election to Congress in 2020. He sits on the Energy and Commerce, Science, Space, and Technology, and Budget committees.

paragraphs.text: Obernolte was born in Chicago in 1970 and graduated from Edison High School in 1988. He earned a bachelor's degree in engineering and applied science from Caltech in 1992, a master's degree in artificial intelligence from UCLA in 1997, and a doctorate in public administration from California Baptist University in 2020. His House biography says he is the only serving member of Congress with a graduate-level degree in AI.

Obernolte worked as a video-game developer and owned a video-game development studio. He served on the Big Bear Lake city council from 2010 to 2014, including as mayor from 2012 to 2014, and his House biography also lists service on the Big Bear Lake Fire Protection District board, the Mojave Desert and Mountain Integrated Waste Authority, the Mountain Regional Transit Authority and the Big Bear City Airport District.

From 2014 to 2020 Obernolte represented the 33rd District in the California State Assembly. He was elected to the U.S. House in November 2020 and took office in 2021, and after redistricting he represents the 23rd District.

In the 2025-2026 Congress he serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee (Communications and Technology, Health, and Commerce, Manufacturing, and Trade subcommittees), the Budget Committee, and the Science, Space, and Technology Committee, where he chairs the Subcommittee on Research and Technology.
According to his House biography, Obernolte lives in Big Bear Lake with his wife, Heather, and their two sons, and is a certified flight instructor and a martial arts teacher.
